response.sql: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), deviations AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, average_unit_price - AVG(average_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation_from_overall_average FROM invoice_averages), results AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation_from_overall_average, deviation_from_overall_average - AVG(deviation_from_overall_average) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS deviation_minus_country_average FROM deviations) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation_from_overall_average, deviation_minus_country_average FROM results ORDER BY deviation_minus_country_average IS NULL, deviation_minus_country_average DESC LIMIT 10;
